fields.label: Certificate Manager Certificates
fields.help: URLs to certificate manager certificate resources that are used to authenticate connections between users and the load balancer.

fields.label: Certificate Map
fields.help: A reference to the CertificateMap resource uri that identifies a certificate map associated with the given target proxy.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Http Keep Alive Timeout Sec
fields.help: Specifies how long to keep a connection open, after completing a response, while there is no matching traffic (in seconds).

fields.label: Proxy Bind
fields.help: This field only applies when the forwarding rule that references this target proxy has a loadBalancingScheme set to INTERNAL_SELF_MANAGED.

fields.label: Quic Override
fields.help: Specifies the QUIC override policy for this resource.

fields.label: Server TLS Policy
fields.help: A URL referring to a networksecurity.ServerTlsPolicy resource that describes how the proxy should authenticate inbound traffic.

fields.label: SSL Certificates
fields.help: URLs to SslCertificate resources that are used to authenticate connections between users and the load balancer.

fields.label: SSL Policy
fields.help: A reference to the SslPolicy resource that will be associated with the TargetHttpsProxy resource.

fields.label: TLS Early Data
fields.help: Specifies whether TLS 1.3 0-RTT Data (ΓÇ£Early DataΓÇ¥) should be accepted for this service.

fields.label: URL Map
fields.help: A reference to the UrlMap resource that defines the mapping from URL to the BackendService.
